tagline: Three Blips in the dark. Only you know which one is the Xenomorph.

featuredCards.title: SIGNAL LOST
featuredCards.caption: He vanishes and his missing Blips return anywhere on the board, one of them secretly him. He heals while they guess which.

featuredCards.title: OUT OF THE SHADOWS
featuredCards.caption: Spend a Blip to attack. If it was the marked one, the Xenomorph bursts out mid-combat and a 2 becomes a 5.

featuredCards.title: ACID FOR BLOOD
featuredCards.caption: Hurting him hurts back. Every point of combat damage they land splashes right back onto the attacker.

featuredCards.title: IT’S USING THE AIR SHAFTS
featuredCards.caption: Win the fight, then gone. The Blips pour back into his zone with him hidden among them, and the guessing starts over.
